verses.text: And what can make you sg realize what the Shocking Event is?
A day when mankind become like scattered moths,
and the mountains become like tufted wool.
So, as for the one whose scales were heavy[1] —
he is in a pleasant life.
But as for the one whose scales were lighta—
And what can make you sg realize what it is?

footnotes.1: Frequently the Qur’an addresses the events of the Hereafter in past tense; this grammatical shift should be pondered by the reader.
footnotes.2: The Arabic word used is ummuhu which literally means ‘his mother’. According to Al-Qurtubi, Hell was described as a mother because the disbeliever heads towards it like a baby heads towards its mother.
